_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Public MCP servers need no manual connection or login. The screen is the default 393x727 phone. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means the name is exactly X. To "open the panel": navigate to /new, press Control+k, fill ".command-palette-input" with "MCP Servers", and click the first ".command-palette-item"; "the panel", the dialog named "MCP Servers" (the element [role="dialog"]:has(.modal-xwide)), should be visible. The server lists one MCP server, "oauth", which needs no authentication, and has no tools. Call "probes" returns how many times the page has asked for its tools. Perform the steps in order. 1. Open the panel. 2. The panel must have no link named "Sign in" (count 0), no column header (role "columnheader") named "Login" (count 0), and no button named "Connect" (count 0). Its button named "Tools" should be visible. 3. Call "probes": it must return "0". 4. Click the panel's button named "Tools". The dialog named "oauth tools" should contain the text "This server has no tools.", and call "probes" must return "1".
